The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for their customers. This strategy is likely to increase their customer retention rates while simultaneously eroding our market share. To mitigate this impact, we must urgently evaluate our own retention strategies, potentially by enhancing our digital engagement tools or introducing competitive loyalty incentives to prevent further customer churn.
